title: Spec frontmatter v1
description: The YAML frontmatter of specs/S-NNNN-<slug>/spec.md, validated as parsed YAML. That the slug matches the folder name, and that the id is the folder's, are checked by `spec apply`.

title.description: Optional. Without it, the index takes the title from the first heading.

repo.description: The repo the spec lives in, by its name in repos.toml.

target_repo.description: Where the spec's work is tried, when that is not `repo`.

status.description: draft: written, not applied. applied: issues exist. done: every ticket closed. dropped: abandoned; the id is not reused.

milestone.description: The milestone the spec belongs to, for the rendered index.

prd.description: The PRD the spec serves: its path in the repo, and optionally its name and draft.

serves.description: The PRD sections this spec serves.

items.description: A YAML flow list splits at commas, so `rows 3, 4` yields the integer 4. Render the list by joining its items with ', '.

records.description: Decision records the spec rests on.
